problem: Nightlogue Conductor posts bot-authored Codex review requests, but Codex does not acknowledge them. Owner-authored requests have completed successfully.
solution: Separate PR creation through the GitHub App from Codex review requests using an owner-authorized fine-grained token. Validate the requester identity, skip when absent or incorrect, preserve exact CI SHA verification, and deduplicate owner-authored comments.
tests: CI unit tests for valid owner, wrong bot identity, missing token, duplicate commit, and changed PR head
Full CI checks for lint, formatting, types, tests, package and Storybook
Owner-token live review still needs a secure GitHub Actions secret and follow-up smoke test
risks: The owner must configure a fine-grained GitHub credential with issue comment permission. GitHub may require organization approval. This PR does not activate live Codex review without that token.
review: Verify the reviewer token is distinct from the GitHub App key, only the approved GitHub identity can send review requests, missing token does not fail CI, and no automatic merge occurs.
